positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a front end developer on the Marketing Cloud helping to prepare the campaigns application for a new release. Worked with Marionette.js and Backbone.js, jQuery, Handlebars.js, and a variety of other frameworks and libraries.
I also developed a web application for one of the Marketing Cloud's largest clients, this application is transitioning them into a more unified user experience within the campaigns application. I was able to work across multiple organizations within the company while actively developing this project.

volunteerExperiences.description: Provide a warm, welcoming environment for at risk children in the Lafayette area. Form a one on one relationship with a child through various activities around campus.

Assist in recruitment of students for the College of Science.
Attend recruiting events, speaking in front of large groups of prospective students and their families. Also conduct personal meetings with students to talk about personal experiences and the opportunities Purdue has to offer.

projects.title: MakeIndy
projects.description:
Lead backend developer for the MakeIndy application and web portal.
MakeIndy is a crowd funding and publicity initiative set up by a group of Orr Fellows to provide an environment for increasing exposure for small startups and projects around Indiana.

projects.title: Indianapolis Cultural Trail
projects.description:
Lead backend developer for the Indianapolis Cultural Trail issue reporting application.
The Indianapolis Cultural Trail is a path around the neighborhoods of downtown Indianapolis. Cultural Trail team members often encounter issues along the path, like broken garbage cans and cracked pathways, this application enables tracking of issues they encounter in an easier and more efficient way.
